```{python}
import polars as pl
import requests
import io
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```


```{python}
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "A": ["X", "B", "C", "X", None],
    "B": [1, 2, 3, 1, -999],
    "C": ["apple", "banana", "cherry", "apple", "n/a"]
})

```


```{python}
df.with_columns(
    pl.when(pl.col('B') < 0).then(None).otherwise(pl.col('B')).alias('B-when'),
    pl.col('B').replace(2,10),
    pl.col('C').replace('apple', 'pear').alias('changes_whole_cell'),
    pl.col('C').str.replace('a', 'o', n=3),
    pl.col('C').str.replace_all('a', 'o').alias('all_partial_strings'),
    pl.col('A').replace('X', 10),
    pl.col('A').replace('B', 20),

    ) 
```
# Filling in missing values

```{python}
df = pl.DataFrame({
     "a": [1, 2, None, 3]
    ,"b": [1.0, 2, float("nan"), None]
    ,"c": [-999, 5, None, 11]
})
```
